items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’d go to my lessons with Julius Baker every weekend at his place up there on 71st Street, off of Broadway.

ctx.x: Persichetti. Oh yeah. I played a lot of his . . .

He was the guy. I was interested in that, although I didn’t really do too much of it. Then I just hung in there for four years. I’d go to my lessons with Julius Baker every weekend at his place up there on 71st Street, off of Broadway. We got to be real good buddies. He wanted to find out – I’d go. He wanted to find out who I took out the previous night. You know what? I was trying to learn those pieces he assigned us, because his lessons, I had – he had three etudes we had to learn from memory, every week. I…
Do you remember any of the books that you were using?
